description:
Create a transparent sprite atlas of 24 separate fantasy RPG status icons, EXACTLY 3 columns by 8 rows. Canvas384x512: each cell128x64; centers x64,192,320 and y32,96,160,224,288,352,416,480. One compact icon inside each cell, maximum48x48, empty transparent margins. No text, labels, letters, grid, frame, background, pedestal, badges or UI circles. Match reference game sprite: hand-drawn pixel-art miniature, crisp clustered pixels, dark local contour, clear 3-tone sculpted light/shadow, cool steel, worn leather, restrained colors, modest highlights. Recognizable solid objects and materials, not flat vector symbols, not glossy mobile icons. Top-left light, subtle 3/4 volume. Each row: same effect, three motifs A/B/C left to right. Rows top to bottom:
1 MAGIC SHIELD pale gold: A magical dome around tiny figure; B radiant shield with glowing rim; C layered translucent barrier blocking spark.
2 RAISED SHIELD steel: A steel shield stopping an arrow; B helmeted defender behind raised shield; C arrow ricocheting off battered steel shield.
3 OPPORTUNIST: A boot leaving a danger circle with dagger striking behind it; B departing figure stabbed from behind; C escaping boot crossed by a pursuing blade.
4 COUNTERATTACK: A sword with curved return arrow; B two opposite blades and return arrow; C shield parrying a blow and a blade thrusting back.
5 COVER ALLY: A shield protecting smaller ally beside it; B two figures sheltered behind large shield; C shield intercepting arrow aimed at ally.
6 WAITING: A hourglass beside crouched figure; B bronze clock with resting figure; C hourglass beside still boot.
7 FIRE ON TILE: A orange flame on floor diamond; B burning embers on stone tile; C three tongues of fire across floor diamond.
8 ACID POOL: A shallow bubbling lime puddle on floor diamond; B irregular acidic pool with bubbles; C green acid puddle corroding floor edges.
